hint: Once $b$ has a value, the parentheses hold a sum you can work out first.

hints.text: Once $b$ has a value, the parentheses hold a sum you can work out first.
With $b = 5$ the expression is $4(5 + 1)$. Add inside the parentheses, then multiply by $4$.

explanation: Replace the letter $b$ with its value $5$ to get $4(5 + 1)$.
Parentheses come first, so add inside them: $5 + 1 = 6$.
Then multiply that sum by the $4$ outside: $4 \times 6 = 24$.
The value of the expression is $24$.
